info.name: Hotel Management System
info.description:
API collection for the ComfyStay Hotel Management System (Express + MongoDB).

## Setup
1. Start the backend (`npm start` in Backend) — default `baseUrl` is `http://localhost:6587/api/v1`.
2. Log in from **🔑 Authentication** to fill tokens automatically, or paste existing tokens into the collection variables:
   - `superAdminToken` (Super Admin, 2FA: login → emailed OTP → verify)
   - `adminToken` (Hotel Admin)
   - `managerToken` / `employeeToken` (Manager / Employee — send `usertype: Employee`)
   - `userToken` (Guest)
3. For bookings without the Razorpay popup, set `razorpayKeySecret` to the **test mode** `RAZORPAY_KEY_SECRET`. The Book Room pre-request script signs a test payment. Never commit a live secret.

## Headers
Protected routes need `authorization: <token>` and `usertype: SuperAdmin | Admin | Employee | User`.

## Folders
- **🧪 End-to-End Booking Flow** — run top to bottom in the Collection Runner to test the complete website flow with assertions.
- Role folders cover every route. Requests marked ⚠️ change or delete real data.
- Uploads use form-data (`image`, `images` or `video` file fields).

Prices are in INR (₹). IDs saved by one request (hotelId, roomId, bookingId, offerCode…) are reused by the next.

item.description:
Walks the whole business flow with assertions:

Register → Discovery → Details → Room Selection → Availability → Booking → Payment → Confirmation → Check-In → Stay → Check-Out → Review → Reports.

**Before running:** fill `superAdminToken`, `managerToken` (a manager assigned to an approved hotel) and `razorpayKeySecret` (test mode secret from Backend/.env). The guest is registered fresh each run. The folder soft-deletes its review, offer and room at the end; bookings and payments stay for reporting.

request.description:
Step 2 — Hotel discovery. Enable any query param to filter.

- `search`: words matched across name, description, address, city, state, country and amenities
- `city` / `state` / `country`: exact (case-insensitive)
- `minRating`: guest rating, or star category when a hotel has no reviews
- `amenities`: comma separated; hotel + room amenities
- `roomType`: single | double | triple | queen | king | suite | deluxe
- `availableOnly=true`, or `checkIn` + `checkOut` for date-based availability
- `minPrice` / `maxPrice`: starting price per night (₹)
- `sortBy`: recommended | rating | likes | price_low | price_high | newest
